facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2020-0221 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 4 November 2020 as a scheduled change under management of change; no event precedes it in the record. The management of change record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
